literal_meaning: বলার মাধ্যমে রাখা (to keep by saying)
figurative_meaning_en: To seek or obtain permission well in advance
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি আগেই বলে রেখেছি যে আমি ছুটি নেব।
তুমি কি বলে রেখেছো অফিসে যে আজ যাবে না?
example_sentences_in_english: I have already informed them that I'll take leave.
Have you given advance notice at the office that you won't go today?
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on courtesy and prior communication in social interactions.
